shape: 512x1024 + length-1024 contiguous bias; last axis; FP32 and FP16; P800-152

protocol.paired_public: Separate processes on the same card, independently calibrated public modules, identical input seeds; blocks randomized AB/BA, 8 warm calls, 38 calls individually synchronized and 40-event batch; 2 discarded + 21 retained blocks each. Submit ends on Python return. Eager remeasured inside each process.
protocol.device: Each independent captured graph replays 16 calls/measurement; 2 sequences for combined eager/fused and 1 for stand-alone eager add and softmax. Timings include the corresponding device work and launch. Isolated medians of individual operators need not sum to the combined median.
protocol.XRE: Host monotonic time at entry to the real xpu_launch_async, captured in separate instrumented runs. Not execution start. CPU and device timelines overlap.
protocol.tiles: Preallocated outputs via C launcher, 64 launches/event sample, 29 retained samples. KL3 assembly counts are static counts, not dynamic transactions.
protocol.excluded: The many-candidate graph-capture sweep and multi-calibration single-process trial timed out. Device replay per graph and independent process AB/BA replaced those measurements.
protocol.stockpair: Actual independently launched v10/v12 images on the same physical card and pinned CPU set. One active worker timed at a time. Two cards per dtype with opposite cold-start order, identical seeds, randomized public/eager and image order, 21 retained blocks; one median per 38 synchronized calls, 40 ordinary submissions per event batch.
protocol.pointer: Sized C launcher receives a fresh checked (address,numel) for dense matrix, bias and output; candidate and baseline use identical kernel geometry, binary and stream. Raw-address and private replay-shortcut runs are diagnostic controls only.
